<a id="page-auth"></a>
# Accounts (feature layer)

The accounts layer: signing app users in, up and out, and managing their account, with `{auth}` to show who is signed in. Open it when a UI has accounts. Its words and actions are allowed only where the host enables the layer (see [levels.md](levels.md)).

<a id="auth-actions"></a>
## Actions

Written in an event as their type and fields by name, as on [events.md](events.md#events-actions).

<a id="action-auth"></a>
### `auth`: Auth

Signs app users in, up and out, and manages their account. A failure's message goes in `errorVariable` (and stops the chain).

Written `auth operation=… email=…`. Level 5.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [AuthOperation](values.md#enum-AuthOperation) | `signIn` |  |
| `email` | text | `""` |  |
| `password` | text | `""` |  |
| `displayName` | text | `""` |  |
| `photoUrl` | text | `""` |  |
| `currentPassword` | text | `""` | Re-authenticates first (change password, delete account). |
| `errorVariable` | text | `""` | Gets a failure's message. |

<a id="auth-examples"></a>
## Examples

The JSON reference's examples for this page, printed in the notation. A `{…}` at the end of a line is what the notation has no words for yet ([_tails.md](_tails.md)).

<a id="auth-example-pages-auth-json"></a>
### pages/auth.json

From [`pages/auth.json`](../auth.md).

```notation
state email=""
state password=""
state authError=""
canvas h=320
Column#col gap=12 pad=24 w={"fill":390} h={"fill":320} crossAxisAlignment=null
  Input#email "Email" w={"fill":342} h={"hug":28} initialValue={email} keyboardType=emailAddress
  Input#password "Password" password w={"fill":342} h={"hug":28} initialValue={password}
  Text#error "{authError}" color=#FFDC2626 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":18} visible={authError != ''}
  Button#go "Sign in" style={"backgroundColor":"#FF2563EB","foregroundColor":"#FFFFFFFF"} w={"fill":342} h=48 onTap={auth operation=signIn email={email} password={password} errorVariable=authError; navigate to=signIn mode=pop}
```
